featured.title: Captcha — Agentic Link Verification & Bilingual Fraud-Awareness AI Platform

bullets.label: Architecture
bullets.text: Built a zero-framework bounded ReAct link investigator (TypeScript, @google/genai, PSL, RDAP, Google Cloud Web Risk, local threat-feed lookup) with 768-dim EN-HI semantic matching, multimodal text/image/TTS coaching, and 5 automated data pipelines across 18 public threat/advisory/dataset sources.

projects.title: Captcha — Agentic Link Verification & Bilingual Fraud-Awareness AI Platform
bullets: Architected a hybrid deterministic-floor + bounded multi-turn LLM link-verification agent (TypeScript, @google/genai, Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite with URL context, Public Suffix List, RDAP, Google Cloud Web Risk, and local threat-indicator lookup), achieving 94.4% deterministic recall in 115 ms (140-case synthetic eval, 0/32 official-domain false alarms) and 100% agent recall on a 30-case stratified sample (~6.1 s, 2.83 calls/case) while eliminating false alarms on newly launched .bank.in domains.

Engineered a bilingual (EN/HI) multimodal PWA (25k+ LOC, React 18, Express, 768-dim gemini-embedding-001 semantic feed matching at 0.967 EN-HI cosine similarity, multimodal text/image/TTS coaching, and 23 human-reviewed traces exported for Gemma 4 SFT distillation) plus 5 automated ingestion pipelines across 18 public threat, advisory, and dataset sources (19/19 live runs, 195 defanged phishing indicators, 851 PII-scrubbed reference messages) deployed on Cloudflare Workers + Dockerized PostgreSQL 16/Express/Caddy within a 736 MB container budget (55/56 API tests passing).

projects.title: Autonomous Multimodal AI Video Production & Publishing Pipeline
bullets: Architected an end-to-end multimodal LLM video production system (14.5k+ LOC Python) orchestrating Groq structured-JSON script/storyboard synthesis across a 40-lesson System Design curriculum, Microsoft Edge-TTS word-boundary audio with broadcast EBU R128 mastering (-14 LUFS), and two offline Playwright Chromium HTML5/SVG/GSAP rendering engines—achieving a ~6x render speedup (~18 min to ~3 min for 67s 1080x1920 30fps masters) with lossless PNG-to-H.264 CRF 14 and zero-reencode stream-copy mastering.

Built a fail-closed two-tier QC gate pairing deterministic FFmpeg QA (loudness, A/V sync, black/freeze detection) with a 4-model Gemini Vision critic (lifting Lesson 1 rubric scores from 70/100 to 99/100) and a 3-loop autonomous self-repair loop, orchestrated via a quota-guarded 4x/day Linux systemd autopilot (6,400/10,000 daily YouTube API units) that published 8 videos cleanly while blocking 5/5 low-score runs, with Meta Graph API Instagram Reels cross-posting and 28 passing unit/FFmpeg integration tests in GitHub Actions CI.
